card.name: Partway through foreign or rare words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long, rare or non-English words, such as Lao script syllables, German or Malay words, and drug or species names. It fires on the unfinished piece, before the word is complete.

modes.label: Lao script syllables
modes.description: Single characters inside Lao-language words, as in the national motto.
modes.example: ສັນຕິພາບ ເ<<ອ>>ກະລາດ ປ

modes.label: Split rare Latin-letter words
modes.description: Middle pieces of German, Malay, or drug and species names that are cut into several parts.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of unusual or foreign words that are split into pieces, not on any particular meaning.
